source.title: Glowing Scorpid Blood
source.objective:
ProgressIn all my time working the Faire, I've learned a lot of things about customers.  Here's one of those nuggets of wisdom: customers love stuff that glows!  It doesn't matter what it is - you could take a broken chair leg and make it glow, and every child will come from miles around to get one!

So, <name>, I need glowing scorpid blood.  You can find it from the scorpids of Sillithus, or the Blasted Lands, or the Burning Steppes.
source.completion:
Great job, <name>!  Thanks a lot!  I'm going to make paint from this blood and turn all kinds of cheap junk into glowing treasure!

Here are your tickets, and thanks again!
